summary: Preview: Sync personal tutorial voice recordings across devices through Google Drive.
Preview: The first two cards of the moving-clocks tutorial now have voice narration. Export a tutorial and its recordings together as one ZIP.
Preview: Record and play tutorial narration, with compact playback controls and the latest Details and graph toolbar updates.
Preview: Expand folded context in one tap from the graph toolbar.
Preview: A compact Details masthead keeps its size while reading text zooms.
Preview: Prefer MP4 for new voice recordings on iPhone and iPad.
Preview: Switch iPhone and iPad audio to playback mode before listening to a recording.
Preview: Release the microphone after recording on iPhone and iPad before playing back a take.
Preview: Record or import tutorial voice narration and listen while card actions play.
Preview: Simpler tutorial editing, optional narration, Show/Hide actions and replayable Fit++ node arrangements.
Preview: Create and record personal tutorials, export/import them and synchronise them through Google Drive.
Minor fixes and fuller acknowledgements
Explore connected explanations through reading trees, with substantially revised teaching content, richer intuition and illustrations throughout SR, GR and supporting mathematics.
Illustrated user guide with desktop and phone examples, and a shorter Quick Start.
Clearer graph overviews, improved guided tutorials content with scrolling and zooming permitted in details view, and better equation layouts
Automatically marked study questions, clearer GR derivations and tangent/cotangent examples, and refined graph context controls.
Clearer phone graph controls, tighter graphic spacing, easier question retries and an in-app version history.
Folded clarifications and improved personal notes, including top-level blocks, mathematical notation and explicit editing.
Content organised into independent domains, supporting smaller subject-specific editions.
A more informative opening graph and an offline Disconnect option when Google sync is paused.
Simpler independent View and Graph controls, with updated guided tutorials.
Reliable app icons, Back/Forward selection navigation and clearer control hints.
Expanded rest-energy guidance, a time-dilation tutorial and improved phone tutorial layout.
Guided tutorials with narration, highlighted controls and Explore/Resume.
Silent synchronisation preserves open content and drafts; clearer reading and question progress totals.
Automatic Google Drive synchronisation, improved completion markers and sequential reading through SR, MATHS and GR.
